differences.what: B is about a third of a stop darker overall; the backdrop and floor go a muddier grey and the scene loses the airy, clean-studio feel A has
Floor in front of and around the base is noticeably greyer and heavier in B (median luminance ~157 vs ~174), so the product sits in a dimmer, less inviting set
The dark teal reflection band on the right side panel starts with a hard horizontal edge in B (around y 680) that reads as a rendering seam; in A it fades in more gradually from the top of the panel
Top lid edge has a few clipped highlights in A (0.5% of the strip) where B holds detail, a minor point in B's favour
Horn and blue waveguide read slightly richer and more luminous in A; in B the blue goes a touch flatter
